test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following figure consists of 4 figures P, Q, R and S. Figure P represents people who are swimmers and figure Q represents acrobats. Figures R and S represent painters and cooks respectively.

In the figure given below, region 8 represents what?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6472837b0d5c686fa3645a9c4897455e84b15da4a6e82a0ff7a80799ea008d3.png]

options.text: People who are cooks and swimmers.
People who are cooks, painters, and acrobats.
People who are swimmers and acrobats.
Those people who are painters and acrobats.

solution:
According to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09f2a1cc509571c45423fa331e7bb6398096e795f0fda7d165dbebb0c2ebda90.png] 

→ Figure P represents people who are swimmers and figure Q represents acrobats. Figures R and S represent painters and cooks respectively.

Here, we can see that region 8 represents those people who are painters and acrobats.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
